#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: neurips-score-status JOB_ID" >&2
  exit 2
fi

job_id=$1
if [[ ! $job_id =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,47}$ ]]; then
  echo "Invalid JOB_ID." >&2
  exit 2
fi

unit=neurips-score-$job_id.service
summary=/srv/neurips-score/jobs/$job_id/state/_batch_summary.json

if systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit"; then
  echo "job_status=running"
